items.text: ETR has taken AJ Brown (knee) out of projections as of now after missed practices and flare-up of degenerative knee issue; biggest offseason red flag was Rams backing out of trade talks partly due to knee concerns.
items.why: Knee flare-up added to ankle; DNP Thu/Fri practices; chronic/degenerative history.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; monitor final report but ETR projecting out.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Pats WRs (Douglas, Williams, Chism).

items.text: ETR projections have removed Emeka Egbuka (concussion, foot) as of now.
items.why: Concussion and foot; limited practice progress insufficient for ETR.
items.implication: Sit; check TB WR depth for fill-ins.

items.text: Lamar Jackson full participant Friday (and prior days); all signs point to return vs Bills after missing three games with ankle.
items.why: Full practices Wed-Fri; Rapoport/others confirm poised for return near 100%.
items.implication: Start Lamar; major upgrade to Ravens offense.
items.opportunity: Unlocks higher volume/efficiency for Flowers, Henry, Andrews/Likely.

items.text: Saquon Barkley on Berry HATE (RB20); usage concerns after limited snaps. Practiced Friday after consecutive DNPs (hamstring/back) but status still uncertain/GTD.
items.why: Back tightness limited to 9 snaps Week 7; DNPs Wed/Thu, returned Fri; dual injuries.
items.conflict: Friday practice improves odds vs pure hate but volume risk remains.

items.text: Carnell Tate (shoulder) removed from ETR projections.
Josh Jacobs following Ashton Jeanty path of strong fantasy value via high-value touches; 3 carries inside the 5 and 13 targets in two games since suspension. Efficiency is bonus.
items.why: Goal-line/red-zone and receiving work dominant post-suspension.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle on Berry's HATE list; production lacking and Chiefs have allowed only one WR TD all season (to JSN).
items.why: Poor recent production + elite Chiefs pass D vs WRs; chest injury lingering.
items.conflict: Limited practice progress may still allow play but matchup overrides.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase full participant Thursday after Wednesday DNP (ankle/rest); on track to play.
Zay Flowers is Berry's WR5 this week; LOVE with Lamar Jackson expected back unlocking the offense.
items.why: Lamar return in projected track-meet vs Bills; Flowers primary beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes with full Lamar offense.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG (top-5 TE both weeks) in two games since Caleb Williams return; leads TE utilization.
items.why: Sustained high target share and production with Williams.

items.text: Derrick Henry on Berry LOVE list (RB6) vs Bills; favorable run matchup and history.
items.why: Bills run D vulnerable; Lamar return boosts overall offense.
items.opportunity: Volume + TD equity with full offense.

items.text: Chase Brown LOVE (RB8) vs TEN; due for TD luck in good spot.
items.why: Soft run defense; TD regression candidate.

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE (RB34) @ LAR; still lacking real role.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba special: post-OC loss, coverage shading, limited supporting cast, yet producing 9 more fantasy points than opportunity implies.
items.why: Outproducing expected opportunity despite scheme/personnel hits.
